principle: Elapsed time changes routing only, never truth, evidence, or authority. A time-based escalation requests a decision from a higher owner; it never silently enlarges the escalating actor's authority. No blocker remains inert or ownerless past its SLA.

classes.hazard: An unresolved technical ambiguity, ownership contest, or integration question stalls reversible work.
A cross-domain data contract is unsafe and the Data Architecture lead has withheld it.
The deputy has held custody of a blocker past its resolution window without entered work.
An owner-exclusive, safety, credential, irreversible, or intent-conflict decision is required.

rules.acyclic_route: Each route is an ordered list of actor_ids with no repeats; it must terminate at the Owner or a role that itself routes to the Owner.
rules.authority_effect_fixed: authority_effect must be request-decision for every class; escalation never grants authority.

ticket_flow.principle: Every question has a first responder that is not the Owner. Intake goes to Help Desk, technical judgement to the IT Manager III, and only an owner-exclusive class reaches P0. An agent that cannot decide files a ticket rather than asking the Owner.

steps.does: Records, triages and completes the ticket contract.

Supplies portfolio, milestone, dependency, WIP, capacity, handoff and risk recommendations. The Data Architecture and Systems Lead reviews applicable cross-domain data contracts and may record WITHHOLD when unsafe.

Decides technical exceptions, scope and architecture choices, sequencing, path and maker ownership, blockers, integration and new authority routing. Help Desk assigns a pod only after the decision is recorded at CONTRACT READY, and the lead acknowledges before ownership is active.
Records MODEL | EFFORT | WHY | ESCALATE WHEN on every assignment and reassignment, risk-and-station based, never rank based.
Implements one ticket from a fresh base in the named isolated lane and returns TICKET|STATUS|OUTCOME / PATH|BASE|HEAD|CLEAN / EVIDENCE / BLOCK / NEXT / MODEL|EFFORT|WHY|ESCALATE WHEN / AUTH receipts.
Verifies the frozen candidate. Functional QA then Experience QA when applicable, at the same head. A changed candidate reopens verification.
Convenes the completion council at READY FOR MAIN. No lead silently self-assigns a shared path.
Records the itemized independence result and chooses WAIT or normal-PR delivery to dev. PASS permits discretion, never a duty. FAIL or UNKNOWN requires WAIT with its rationale and retry trigger.
Records each resulting fact without collapsing integration, hosting, resolution, promotion-packet readiness or release.
Repeats the completion council at RESOLVED so overlaps and authority stay visible without creating an assignment.

ticket_flow.handoff_rule: Cross-family handoffs keep the three events distinct. A failed transport proves neither receipt nor acceptance, and must never create a duplicate assignment.
ticket_flow.owner_is_last_resort: An agent routes an undecidable question to the IT Manager III as a ticket. The Owner is reached only through an owner-exclusive escalation class, never because an agent preferred to ask.
